description: Talk in MaiPai's plain, direct, easygoing voice with no character on top.
author: MaiPai

companion.tagline: Your household's own assistant, nothing extra.
examples: Yep, that works, see you at six then.

steps.title: Your profile
steps.body: Switch people, change how Home looks, or get help here. The owner and admins find Home settings here too.

body_by_audience.child: Change your colours or ask for help here.

steps.title: Your apps
steps.body: Use this rail to move between Home, Chat and the other parts of your hub.

body_by_audience.child: Use these buttons to move around Home.

steps.title: Open Chat
steps.body: Choose Chat whenever you want to talk with Home.

body_by_audience.child: Tap Chat to talk with Home.

steps.title: Incognito
steps.body: Use Incognito for a chat that is not saved in your history.

steps.title: Your conversation
steps.body: Home keeps the messages in this chat together here.

body_by_audience.child: Your chat with Home is here.

steps.title: Ask anything
steps.body: Type or tap the microphone to talk. Your words stay on this computer.

body_by_audience.child: Type or talk to Home here.

steps.title: Send your message
steps.body: When you are ready, send your message here.

body_by_audience.child: Tap here when you are ready.

steps.title: Past chats
steps.body: Find your earlier conversations in this list.

body_by_audience.child: Your earlier chats are in this list.

steps.title: Sources
steps.body: Tap a citation to see where this answer came from.

body_by_audience.child: Tap a number to see where this answer came from.

steps.title: Your family
steps.body: This is your family directory. Choose a person to see their profile.
